description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing channels in Mattermost, including creating, updating, fetching, and managing channel memberships and properties.

methods.name: selectChannel
methods.description: Creates an action to select a channel by its ID.

methods.name: createChannel
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new channel and dispatches relevant actions, including adding the channel to initial category.

methods.name: createDirectChannel
methods.description: Creates a direct message channel between two users and updates preferences and state accordingly.

methods.name: markGroupChannelOpen
methods.description: Marks a group channel as open in user preferences.

methods.name: createGroupChannel
methods.description: Creates a group channel with multiple users, manages existing membership, and updates state.

methods.name: patchChannel
methods.description: Patches channel properties via API and dispatches updated channel data.

methods.name: setMyChannelAutotranslation
methods.description: Enables or disables auto-translation for a channel for the current user.

methods.name: updateChannelPrivacy
methods.description: Updates the privacy setting of a channel.

methods.name: convertGroupMessageToPrivateChannel
methods.description: Converts a group message to a private channel and moves it to the default category.

methods.name: updateChannelNotifyProps
methods.description: Updates notification properties for a channel for a user.

methods.name: getChannelByNameAndTeamName
methods.description: Fetches a channel by team and channel name.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Fetches a channel by its ID.

methods.name: getChannelAndMyMember
methods.description: Fetches a channel and the current user's membership info in one call.

methods.name: getChannelTimezones
methods.description: Retrieves timezones associated with a channel.

methods.name: fetchChannelsAndMembers
methods.description: Fetches channels and their members for a team.

methods.name: fetchAllMyChannelMembers
methods.description: Fetches all channel memberships for the current user.

methods.name: fetchAllMyTeamsChannels
methods.description: Fetches all channels across all teams for the current user.

methods.name: getChannelMembers
methods.description: Fetches members of a channel with pagination.

methods.name: leaveChannel
methods.description: Removes the current user from a channel.

methods.name: joinChannel
methods.description: Adds a user to a channel, either by ID or name, and updates state.

methods.name: deleteChannel
methods.description: Deletes a channel via API.

methods.name: unarchiveChannel
methods.description: Unarchives a channel.

methods.name: updateApproximateViewTime
methods.description: Updates the user's approximate view time for a channel.

methods.name: unsetActiveChannelOnServer
methods.description: Marks the current channel as inactive on the server.

methods.name: readMultipleChannels
methods.description: Marks multiple channels as read.

methods.name: getChannels
methods.description: Fetches channels for a team with pagination.

methods.name: getArchivedChannels
methods.description: Fetches archived channels for a team.

methods.name: getAllChannelsWithCount
methods.description: Fetches all channels with total count, with various filtering options.

methods.name: getAllChannels
methods.description: Fetches all channels with optional filtering.

methods.name: autocompleteChannels
methods.description: Provides autocomplete suggestions for channels.

methods.name: autocompleteChannelsForSearch
methods.description: Provides autocomplete suggestions for channels in search.

methods.name: searchChannels
methods.description: Searches channels within a team.

methods.name: searchAllChannels
methods.description: Searches across all channels with options.

methods.name: searchGroupChannels
methods.description: Searches group channels.

methods.name: getChannelStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics for a channel.

methods.name: getChannelsMemberCount
methods.description: Fetches member counts for multiple channels.

methods.name: addChannelMember
methods.description: Adds a user to a channel.

methods.name: addChannelMembers
methods.description: Adds multiple users to a channel in batches.

methods.name: removeChannelMember
methods.description: Removes a user from a channel.

methods.name: markChannelAsRead
methods.description: Marks a channel as read and updates view time.

methods.name: markMultipleChannelsAsRead
methods.description: Marks multiple channels as read.

methods.name: markChannelAsViewedOnServer
methods.description: Marks a channel as viewed on the server.

methods.name: actionsToMarkChannelAsRead
methods.description: Generates actions to mark a channel as read, updating counts and last viewed.

methods.name: actionsToMarkChannelAsUnread
methods.description: Generates actions to mark a channel as unread, updating counts and mentions.

methods.name: getChannelMembersByIds
methods.description: Fetches specific channel members by user IDs.

methods.name: getChannelMember
methods.description: Fetches a specific user's membership in a channel.

methods.name: getMyChannelMember
methods.description: Fetches current user's membership in a channel.

methods.name: loadMyChannelMemberAndRole
methods.description: Loads current user's channel membership and roles, then loads roles.

methods.name: favoriteChannel
methods.description: Moves a channel to the Favorites category.

methods.name: unfavoriteChannel
methods.description: Moves a channel out of Favorites to its default category.

methods.name: updateChannelScheme
methods.description: Updates the scheme of a channel.

methods.name: updateChannelMemberSchemeRoles
methods.description: Updates roles for a channel member.

methods.name: membersMinusGroupMembers
methods.description: Fetches channel members excluding group members.

methods.name: getChannelModerations
methods.description: Fetches moderation settings for a channel.

methods.name: patchChannelModerations
methods.description: Updates moderation settings for a channel.

methods.name: getChannelMemberCountsByGroup
methods.description: Fetches member counts grouped by groups.

methods.name: fetchMissingChannels
methods.description: Fetches channels by IDs if missing from store, with batching.

methods.name: fetchIsRestrictedDM
methods.description: Checks if a direct message channel is restricted.

methods.name: getChannelAccessControlAttributes
methods.description: Fetches access control attributes for a channel.
